title: NASA Global Climate Change - Vital Signs of the Planet
summary: Earth's global average surface temperature in 2023 was the warmest on record since modern recordkeeping began in 1880. Human activities, primarily greenhouse gas emissions, drive current global warming trends.

title: Wikipedia - Cat
summary: Cat, domestic feline (Felis catus), has been associated with humans for at least 9,500 years. Despite being classified as carnivores, they are opportunistic feeders and consume a wide range of prey, including rodents, birds, and insects.

title: Wikipedia - Dog
summary: The dog (Canis familiaris or Canis lupus familiaris) is a domesticated mammal that evolved from the wolf. It is widely regarded as one of humanity's earliest domesticated animals and has been selectively bred for millennia to exhibit a vast range of traits, including size, coat color, temperament, and working abilities. Dogs play diverse roles in human society, serving as companions, working dogs, service animals, and assistance animals.
